contrarian_angles.head: online booking software
contrarian_angles.consensus: 6 of 9 organic results are ranked lists of apps ('best' or a number in the title or description); 0 of those 6 name an industry beyond the head's own words
contrarian_angles.counted_by: regex on title + description: best, top N or N best; then the industry words of the pillar rules (salon, clinic, fitness, spa, physio and others)
contrarian_angles.counter_claim: Buyers don't shop for 'booking software' in general: they shop for booking software for their kind of business. A guide that picks by industry beats one more ranked list.
contrarian_angles.evidence: In this run's Search Console data, 13,150 of the 29,710 impressions on booking queries (44%) came from queries that name an industry (salon, clinic, fitness, spa, physio and others).
contrarian_angles.risk: A critic will say the head term itself names no industry, so a guide split by industry may not rank for it. Answer the head in the first section, then split by industry.

contrarian_angles.head: salon software
contrarian_angles.consensus: 5 of 9 organic results are ranked lists of apps ('best' or a number in the title or description); 0 of those 5 name an industry beyond the head's own words
contrarian_angles.counted_by: regex on title + description: best, top N or N best; then the industry words of the pillar rules (salon, clinic, fitness, spa, physio and others)
contrarian_angles.no_angle_because: Nothing in this run contradicts or narrows the consensus: no Search Console, DataForSEO or status count from this run speaks against a ranked list for this head, and the lists already name the industry.
contrarian_angles.evidence_needed: a count from your own data that the lists get wrong, such as the share of salon queries asking about a feature none of the listed apps covers
